purpose: Read-only, time-aligned search/GA observations; immutable private traffic sensitivity reports; mandatory browser telemetry isolation.

analysisPolicy.timeAlignment: PT GSC calendar boundaries mapped to actual UTC hours and then GA property timezone; handle 23/25-hour DST days.
analysisPolicy.segmentation: Separate page_view event queries for raw, review paths, non-review, exact suspected minute/source/path rules, and sensitivity remainder; arithmetic checks.
analysisPolicy.interpretation: Rule matches remain suspected; remainder is not a verified human audience. Do not subtract overlapping user/session counts.
analysisPolicy.providerUnknowns: API failures, missing totals and empty Bing stats remain unknown; Bing registered URL is read before its stats query.
analysisPolicy.sideEffects: New private snapshots only; no settings mutation, indexing request or publication.

browserPolicy.runtime: Pinned playwright-core 1.64.1 with installed Chrome/Chromium; fresh temporary browser contexts.
browserPolicy.default: Block Google tag/vendor hosts, known collection paths and GA-shaped request payloads before navigation; block service workers.
browserPolicy.tagVerification: Only exact HTTPS GET library for this measurement ID; collection remains blocked.
browserPolicy.privacy: Record counters only; no raw telemetry payloads, request URLs, cookies or identifiers.

limits: No actor identity is established from aggregated traffic.
Bing performance comparison remains unavailable if its API returns an empty array.
Unknown custom telemetry proxies are not universally discoverable by a URL/payload classifier.
Historical events cannot be retroactively blocked by future browser isolation.
